name: stag

attributes.attribute: the horned male of the deer
wears the antlers of a stag
linked to the power of the wildwood

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The stag is a mythic animal. It is the horned male of the deer. It holds a strong place in the images of the god Cernunnos. He wears antlers in many sculptures and reliefs. The horns are those of a stag, not of a tame beast. So the stag carries the power of the wildwood. Deer sprout antlers in the spring and shed them in the fall. The stag thus also marks the turn of the seasons. In story the stag stands for the wild and the hunt. It is the great beast of the woods.
